text: The source-owner labels in the sourceReuse metadata of the entries858–860 audit are corrected here: [original audit](../records/11531d534ebde6401cdf74a2859e31be63a4dbc448b3395941064b57d38b1c27.json). At revision0b93f0f7a926ed94c8a0646f18b6734ec7cc0f6d, Rust Delete/ReadFlagChange branches belong to DoSyncMessagesForFolder::do_operation, not the wrapper sync_messages_for_folder. C++ OnReadStatusChanged/OnMessageDeleted belong to ExchangeMessageSyncHandler, not MessageSyncListener. The exact callback behavior, source paths and revision in that audit stay valid; these enclosing symbol names are the correction. Definitions are anchored at Rust25–41 and C++88–101; operation branches at 265–295 and callbacks320–361. This adds no chronological coverage or runtime evidence.
title: Correct source owners for current Exchange message synchronization
